label: 探索性 (EXPLORATORY)
question: 一个通用规划器在与本方法相同的约束下，能否完成完整采摘？ (BL5 fairness supplement: BL5e)
status_statement: Stage B was judged NOT PASSED. H4179 is exploratory, not a formal confirmation, and changes no earlier verdict.

reference_only.ours: H4178 exp1 control R1-R3 / stage-B screening & runs / H4178 exp3b
reference_only.original_BL5: H4178 exp2 / exp3a / exp3b BL5 units

unchanged: landing exemption 300 N / 25 periods / 8 mm for all methods

config.library: ompl 2.0.1 (pip wheel, side-installed; same as H4178 BL5)
config.approach_axis: blade face along the blade normal from either side: cut pose = cut point + side * offset * n, pre pose = cut point + side * (offset + standoff) * n
config.seed: OMPL RNG seeded once with the registered process seed (H4178 configure); Halton cut samples are seed-independent
config.name: BL5e
config.range_rationale: full gate-admissible ranges: cut zone 0.17 m petiole / 0.10 m stalk (x0.95), blade face half extents 0.055 x 0.0375 m (x0.9)
config.dynamic_alignment_rule: reject above gate-1 deg; score penalty above gate-1.5 deg
config.ranking_dev4: survivors ranked by min(margin, 8 mm) descending, then by L-inf joint distance from the current state to the pre-cut pose (shorter first); alignment to the DYNAMIC axis <= gate-1 deg required (judge Blade scope)
config.dev5: on-segment tracking command: the joint target sent to the frozen bounded_command is the furthest point of the CURRENT verified path segment whose per-joint step from the joint-target cache stays inside the unsaturated action range (|desired-cache| <= scale) and inside lead of the actual state, so per-joint action clipping no longer bends the executed motion off the verified segment (dev 4 near-miss 1.957 mm at frame 477 was a per-waypoint corner deviation)
config.dev4: direct joint-linear path first, best-of-8 RRTConnect (shortest), per-frame execution monitoring with fresh evidence, Blade-scope rule for Blade-current gaps < 3 mm
config.guarded_push_rule: dev 3: 1 mm/2 frames along approach line, fresh-evidence 3 mm check, max 15 mm; contact window widened to [-4,+6] mm
config.refine_method: scipy Nelder-Mead over (s,u,v,psi,alignment,offset), clipped to the ranges
config.score: min(nonblade margin excl. current Blade, cap) - 1.0*contact window violation - 0.05*face shortfall - 1.0 if unreachable/gate
config.ranking: refined candidates with score >= clearance and pre-pose valid, descending min(cut-pose margin, pre-pose margin)
config.gate_geometry: audit authored cut point and authored axis of the expected object (the quantities object_cut_audit measures the gates against); dev 2
config.cut_request_rule: CUT requested only on the final approach / at the cut pose and only when ObjectBladeInterlock on the current measured audit permits (same rule as our method: request_when_physically_ready); dev 2
config.replan_wait_rationale: 40 frames between failed plans: 10 replans span ~440 frames < uniform 480-frame no-release stop; dev 2 (dev 1 used 10 and exhausted the budget in ~110 frames while the released P2 was still falling)

step0.collision_consistency: BL5E_COLLISION_MODEL_CHECK.json passed (0 planner-safe/judge-violation configurations in 2000; 0 predicted>=3mm/recorded<2mm)
step0.cut_pose_sampling: Halton samples over the full gate-admissible ranges, measured against the audit authored cut point/axis (the quantities the simulator gates use); dynamic-axis Blade-scope rule
step0.exit_rule: same as ours: after each real release, exit until all tool-object pairs >= 2 mm for 3 boundaries (120-frame hold timeout)
step0.budget: 300 s per RRTConnect solve (best-of-8 within 900 s per planning call), <= 10 replans per object
step0.cut_request: CUT requested only when ObjectBladeInterlock on the measured audit permits (same rule as our method)

runs.note: first BL5e pipeline run: wide gate-range sampling + Nelder-Mead refinement + exit hold, 3 mm
dev 2: plan on audit authored gate geometry; CUT only when measured gates permit (same rule as ours); replan wait 40 frames
dev 3: guarded push at cut pose (1mm/2 frames, <=15mm, fresh 3mm check); contact window [-4,+6] mm
dev 4: execution monitoring (fresh evidence each frame), Blade-scope rule (dynamic axis), direct path first, best-of-8 RRTConnect shortest, length-aware ranking
dev 5: on-segment tracking command (no per-joint action saturation off the verified segment); shortcut smoothing tested offline and rejected (3.14/2.67 -> 2.58 rad)

development.post_dev5_change: mode label set to idle when an exit finishes (record label only; no behaviour change)

disclosures: Cut-pose sampling ranges and the blade-face threshold were chosen after inspecting the gate quantities used by our method (gate definitions, not our trajectories).
The original BL5 slack bound was a pruning bound only; BL5e uses the full gate-admissible ranges.
Original BL5 planned against the runtime oracle cut point/axis (~7 cm / ~2.6 deg from the authored geometry the gates measure); this is reported as a contributor to its weakness.

Offline analyses on recorded dev states (not counted as dev runs): RRTConnect / RRT* / BIT* on the P0 query (only RRTConnect solved, 1 of 4 tries in 300 s, 2.67-3.14 rad); shortcut smoothing 2.67 -> 2.58 rad (rejected); our method path 1.27 rad.

Dev changes: authored gate geometry + gated CUT (dev 2), guarded 1 mm push + contact window (dev 3), execution monitoring + Blade scope + survivor ranking + best-of RRT (dev 4), on-segment tracking command (dev 5).
Up to 3 units run concurrently (12 CPU cores); planning budgets are wall-clock, so CPU sharing may shorten effective planning time slightly; controller/planning wall times are recorded per run.
uniform_administrative_stop: no new real release within 480 frames of the previous release (episode start) -> stop; 180-minute wall cap per unit

predictions.T1: BL5e cuts P2 with both physical gates (5/5 predicted), releases and exits it; at P0 the generic planner finds valid cut poses but RRTConnect rarely solves the narrow passage within 300 s and the solved paths are 2.3-3.1 rad (ours 1.27 rad), so under the frozen speed limit the uniform 480-frame no-release stop (or the 10-replan limit) ends the run before the P0 CUT. Predicted full harvest 0/5, furthest stage petiole2_exit 5/5, safety passed 5/5 (dev 5: 0 safety failures).
predictions.T2: Ours: 9/10 tiers cannot start (stage-B screening), CONTACT_DROP3_FORCE08 0/3 (stage B). BL5e: P2 CUT on most tiers (the cut-pose sampler is geometry driven), full harvest 0/30 predicted; CONTACT tier: contact gate degraded, P2 CUT uncertain.
predictions.T3: Ours: refused before physics on all 5 unseen geometries (H4178 exp3b). BL5e: predicted full harvest 0/15; P2 CUT on some scenes; no claim beyond descriptive counts.
predictions.BL5e_vs_BL5: Original BL5 (H4178) never executed a gated CUT (furthest stage none / P2 dwell). BL5e predicted to go further (P2 CUT) on T1 and most T2/T3 units; McNemar on full harvest uninformative (0 vs 0 predicted); furthest-stage comparison reported descriptively.

stop_rules.disk: free >= 1500 MiB before every launch, otherwise stop; remaining units NOT_STARTED
stop_rules.strict_denominator: started = counted; not started = NOT_STARTED; no rerun or overwrite; no parameter change after results
stop_rules.safety: any BL5e safety violation: SAFETY_STOP_REPORT; in T1 the whole queue pauses for the user decision; in T2/T3 report and continue

statistics.paired: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on discordant pairs) on full harvest (landing mode) and on reaching the P2 CUT with gates: BL5e vs ours, BL5e vs original BL5, pairs = same scene/tier and same seed (T1: seeds 78101-78103; T2: seed 78201 per tier; T3: scene seed per scene); ours on T2/T3 = stage-B / H4178 reference outcome per tier/scene
statistics.pooling: never pooled across T1/T2/T3 or versions

concurrency.rule: T2 starts after every T1 unit is judged; T3 after T2
